display.title: Finale: The Ender Dragon
display.subtitle: Beat the pack - unlock Ad Astra
description: The Ender Dragon is the pack finale. But she will not manifest until you
have proven yourself in the End: reach the outer islands, find an End City,
slay Shulkers and Endermen, then summon her with a Dragon Summoning Crystal
Defeat her and the post-game opens: the road to the stars - Ad Astra.
§7This is the terminal gate. There is no token threshold beyond it -
